mandate: C334 — test the cross-sectional intraday KYLE'S LAMBDA / PRICE-IMPACT COEFFICIENT SEASONAL DISLOCATION mean-reversion statistical-arbitrage family on 10 USDT-M linear perps at native 5m (864 pre-registered configs). Per (weekday,tod) bucket, trailing L same-bucket occurrences: klambda_sv=sum(r*f)/sum(f^2) (price impact per unit signed flow), klambda_notional=sum(r*n)/sum(n^2) (per unit notional), impact_var=klambda_sv^2*var(f) (normalized impact-variance component); score=-dislocation vs trailing seasonal mean at same bucket. Signals: klambda_dev, klambda_notional_dev, impact_var_dev. Single-leg dollar-neutral perp PnL with costs on turnover (symmetric and perp_heavy). Gates: Holm+BH at alpha=0.05 (BOTH), MDE, stability, and price-impact-coefficient-vs-placebo attribution. PRE-REGISTERED NaN policy: lambda denominator<=0 -> NaN; var(f)<=0 -> NaN; same-bucket trailing stats NaN-aware min_periods=L excluding NaN obs; NaN-score bars weight 0; raw log_return/signed_volume/notional/trade_count fields carry zero NaN.

data_quality.note: price-impact score NaN share is dominated by structural warmup (first ~L same-bucket occurrences per bucket) plus min_periods windows; zero-variance/non-positive denominators add negligible mass.

methodology.raw_features: log_return=log(c[t]/c[t-1]) (r[0]=0) from real strictly-positive perp_close; signed_volume/notional real from C312.
methodology.signals: per (weekday,tod) bucket over trailing L same-bucket bars: klambda_sv=sum(r*f)/sum(f^2), klambda_notional=sum(r*n)/sum(n^2), impact_var=klambda_sv^2*var(f); score=-(v-trailing seasonal mean of v at same bucket); causal shift(1), cross-sectional rank, dollar-neutral gross 1.0; NaN-score assets weight 0.
methodology.pnl: single-leg perp: pnl = sum_i pos_i * perp_ret_i.
methodology.costs: charged on turnover; symmetric = fee+slip; perp_heavy = 1.5*fee+slip.
methodology.missing_data: non-finite -> NaN; never impute/ffill; insufficient valid obs -> NaN -> not traded (fail-closed).
methodology.multiple_testing: one-sided paired t-test of per-split OOS net vs 0; Holm step-down AND Benjamini-Hochberg over all 864 configs at alpha=0.05.
methodology.attribution: reference config signal nets vs klambda_placebo (per-asset permuted returns, same positions); shares=|net|/sum(|buckets|).
methodology.stability: sign consistency >= 0.70 of splits AND first/second-half Sharpe corr >= 0.5.
